column1: # Plan rollout, run fake-run: A new hostkeeper version rolled out to the farm. Written by `hostkeeper-measure analyze` from the run's records.
# A raw row is one value of a measure; a derived row is computed from the raw rows of its measure,
# as its how column says. A time is the difference of two stamps of the one clock its how column
# names: the coordinator's (whole seconds; a host's heartbeat stamp up to one poll interval late)
# or the runner's (up to one poll interval late). A last value is only of a complete repetition.
